description_en: Queries the alert records of an alert rule
description_zh: 调用SearchAlertHistories接口查询报警规则的报警发送记录
name: SearchAlertHistories

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the SearchAlertRules operation and view the `Id` parameter in the response. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则ID，可调用SearchAlertRules接口获取（对应返回参数中的`Id`），详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.name: alert_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the alert rule. Valid values:

`1`: a custom alert rule that is used to monitor drill-down data sets
`3`: a custom alert rule that is used to monitor tiled data sets
`4`: an alert rule that is used to monitor web pages, including the default alert rule for browser monitoring
`5`: an alert rule that is used to monitor applications, including the default alert rule for application monitoring
`6`: the default alert rule for browser monitoring
`7`: the default alert rule for application monitoring
`8`: a Tracing Analysis alert rule
`101`: a Prometheus alert rule
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则类型：

`1`：基于下钻数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`3`：基于平铺数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`4`：前端监控报警规则，包含默认前端监控报警规则（AlertType=6）。
`5`：应用监控报警规则，包含默认应用监控报警规则（AlertType=7）。
`6`：默认前端监控报警规则。
`7`：默认应用监控报警规则。
`8`：链路追踪Tracing Analysis报警规则。
`101`：Prometheus报警规则
parameters.name: alert_type

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果分页的页码。默认为`1`
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果分页的每页项目数量。默认为`10`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Default value: `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp of the LONG data type. Unit: milliseconds. The default value is 10 minutes before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询报警历史记录的开始时间的时间戳。格式为Unix Timestamp Long，单位为毫秒。默认为当前时间的前10分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp of the LONG data type. Unit: milliseconds. The default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询报警历史记录的结束时间的时间戳。格式为Unix Timestamp Long，单位为毫秒。默认为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

AlarmContent.description_en: The content of the alert notification
AlarmContent.example: "报警名称：Alert1\n报警时间：2020-07-24 12:14:00\n报警内容：共有4条记录触发异常：****"

AlarmResponseCode.description_en: The response code returned after the alert notification was sent
AlarmResponseCode.description_zh: 报警投递返回的状态码

AlarmSources.description_en: The webhook URL, such as the webhook URL of a DingTalk chatbot
AlarmSources.description_zh: 报警Webhook（如钉钉机器人Webhook地址）

AlarmTime.description_en: The time when the alert notification was sent

AlarmType.description_en:
The type of the alert rule. Default value: 4. Valid values:

`1`: a custom alert rule that is used to monitor drill-down data sets
`3`: a custom alert rule that is used to monitor tiled data sets
`4`: an alert rule that is used to monitor web pages, including the default alert rule for browser monitoring
`5`: an alert rule that is used to monitor applications, including the default alert rule for application monitoring
`6`: the default alert rule for browser monitoring
`7`: the default alert rule for application monitoring
`8`: a Tracing Analysis alert rule
`101`: a Prometheus alert rule
AlarmType.description_zh:
报警规则类型（默认为4）：

`1`：基于下钻数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`3`：基于平铺数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`4`：前端监控报警规则，包含默认前端监控报警规则（AlertType=6）。
`5`：应用监控报警规则，包含默认应用监控报警规则（AlertType=7）。
`6`：默认前端监控报警规则。
`7`：默认应用监控报警规则。
`8`：链路追踪Tracing Analysis报警规则。
`101`：Prometheus监控报警规则

Emails.description_en: The email address of the alert contact

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert notification

Phones.description_en: The mobile phone number of the alert contact

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 查询结果分页的每页项目数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
